generation_archetype.label: Quality, batch record, audit, and certification
generation_archetype.focus: lot IDs, certificates, checklist status, test results, specifications, non-conformities, and missing artifacts
perfect_guidance: Use exact lot, certificate, checklist, conformance, or missing-artifact facts.
A missing or incomplete status is valid only when the evidence explicitly says ABSENT, INCOMPLET, missing, or equivalent.
ambiguous_guidance: Use one supported artifact, test, checklist, or lot fact.
Pair it with one unresolved limitation about audit completeness, missing attachments, traceability, or certification coverage.
wrong_guidance: Mutate lot number, conformance status, missing artifact, test result, supplier, or certificate.
Do not leave any unsupported quality claim partially grounded.
